name: Dr. Dennis Trautwein
description: Dennis is a software engineer based in Germany who enjoys building things that live on the internet and also power the internet. Dennis joined the ProbeLab team at Protocol Labs in 2022 and has been instrumental in building much of the P2P Networking infrastructure and tooling that probes several big blockchain networks. He was awarded a PhD research fellowship from Protocol Labs and graduated his PhD at the Georg August University of Göttingen in early 2026.
